formulas.LBS: v' = Σ(w_i * M_i) * v  — linear blend of bone matrices
formulas.DQS: v' = (Σ w_i * dq_i) normalized, then apply — preserves rotation arcs
formulas.FABRIK: Iterative forward+backward reaching, each pass preserves bone lengths

lbs_dqs_test.LBS_artifact: vertex collapses to axis (X=0) — candy wrapper
lbs_dqs_test.DQS_correctness: vertex rotates through Z — preserves volume

implementation_notes: Use DQS for character limbs (arms, legs) — no twist artifacts
Use LBS for facial blendshapes (faster, no rotation arc needed)
